description: Golden + distractor corpus for T3 attachment-content similarity. Cannonsville is the source extract; related targets share water-supply forestry language without the token Cannonsville so keyword search misses them.

documents.title: Cannonsville watershed basin timber sale
documents.text:
New York City Department of Environmental Protection
Bureau of Water Supply - Natural Resources Division
CARPENTERS EDDY EAST
Forest Management Project # 5116
NOTICE OF PROJECT AVAILABILITY
Description: The City of New York will sell 187 MBF of hardwood sawtimber and 89 cords of hardwood pulp through Carpenters Eddy East Forest Management Project #5116 in the Cannonsville watershed basin.
Summary: This sale is comprised of mostly mature red oak and white ash. The project includes 2.5 miles of trail construction and 27 acres of shelterwood regeneration.
Project Area: 103 ac +/-
Total Volume: 187 MBF +/- sawtimber & 89 cords hardwood pulp
Species as a percent of total sawtimber volume: 49% Red Oak, 22% White Ash, 14% Red Maple, 9% Chestnut Oak.
Show Dates: Prospective bidders should attend one of the public showings to receive the full bid package.
Bid Deadline: Sealed bids must be received by the date stated in the official notice.

documents.title: Ashokan reservoir lands — standing timber harvest
documents.text: Department of Environmental Protection, Bureau of Water Supply, Natural Resources Division. Notice of project availability for a forest management sale on water-supply lands adjacent to the Ashokan reservoir. 140 MBF of hardwood sawtimber and 60 cords of pulpwood. Shelterwood regeneration on roughly 22 acres with limited skid-trail construction. Species mix dominated by red oak and hard maple. Sealed bids; show dates for prospective purchasers of standing timber on city-owned watershed property.

documents.title: Pepacton basin forest management — pulp and sawtimber
documents.text: NYC DEP Bureau of Water Supply will offer hardwood pulp and sawtimber from a forest management project in the Pepacton basin of the city water-supply system. Project includes shelterwood cuts, trail work, and regeneration of mature oak-ash stands on reservoir buffer parcels. Volume reported in MBF and cords. Bidders must attend a field showing. This is an environmental land / timber disposition on water-supply holdings, not a generic surplus sale.

documents.title: IT professional services — cloud migration support
documents.text: Request for proposals for information technology consulting services including cloud infrastructure migration, application modernization, cybersecurity assessment, and help-desk augmentation. Vendors must hold relevant cloud certifications. No forestry, watershed, timber, or reservoir content.

documents.title: Open competitive examination — Caseworker
documents.text: Notice of examination for Caseworker. Application period, exam fee, minimum qualifications including a baccalaureate degree, and civil service list establishment procedures. No environmental or land disposition content.

documents.title: Street resurfacing — Borough of Queens
documents.text: Invitation to bid for asphalt resurfacing and milling of selected streets in Queens. Traffic maintenance, night work provisions, and M/WBE goals. Unrelated to watershed forestry.
